market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $55,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$77K on Apr 29 with downward pressure, off ~$17K from year ago. Window is Nov 24 2025 to Dec 31 2026. Need ~29% drawdown over 8 months in volatile bear conditions. Macro uncertainty (Fed, Iran/oil) supports continued volatility; a touch of $55K within 8 months is more likely than not.
data_sources: Yahoo Finance BTC values continue to fall this week
assessment.key_uncertainty: BTC has already shown weakness; whether selling intensifies vs. stabilizes depends on Fed policy and macro
